description: Capability for the main window. `core:default`, plus the window permission the header's drag region needs; double-click maximize goes through `internal_toggle_maximize`, which `core:default` already allows. `os:default` for the OS plugin. Nothing of the dialog plugin: the file and folder pickers are opened from Rust, by `pick_files`, `pick_file` and `pick_folders`, so Rust records what the user chose. Commands this application registers itself need no capability entry.
